statement.zh-TW: 能依步驟①到⑤的順序，檢查一筆交易記完之後三張報表的變化：先看五層利益，再逐一核對四個勾稽點
statement.en: Check the three statements after a transaction in the order of steps 1 to 5: look at the five profit levels first, then work through the four check points one by one

text.zh-TW: 以為五步驟只是填表的順序，填完報表就不用再核對
text.en: Thinking the five steps are only an order for filling in the statements, with no checking needed once they are filled in

text.zh-TW: 以為步驟①的五層利益也有兩邊要比對
text.en: Thinking that step 1, the five profit levels, also has two sides to compare

text.zh-TW: 只要資產負債表左右相等，就以為三張報表全部正確
text.en: Assuming all three statements are right as long as the balance sheet balances

text.zh-TW: 以為一筆交易只會動到一張報表
text.en: Thinking a transaction affects only one statement

statement.zh-TW: 能說出四個勾稽點各自比對哪兩個數字、來自哪兩張報表，並用步驟編號稱呼它們（字母只是別名）
statement.en: Say which two figures each of the four check points compares and which two statements they come from, calling them by step number (the letters are only aliases)

text.zh-TW: 以為步驟②比對的是本期淨利，而不是稅前淨利
text.en: Thinking step 2 compares profit for the period rather than profit before tax

text.zh-TW: 以為步驟③比對的是本期現金增減額，而不是期末現金餘額
text.en: Thinking step 3 compares the net change in cash rather than the closing cash balance

text.zh-TW: 以為步驟④永遠是「本期淨利等於未分配盈餘的餘額」，忽略期初餘額與股利
text.en: Thinking step 4 is always ‘profit for the period equals the balance of unappropriated retained earnings’, ignoring the opening balance and dividends

text.zh-TW: 以為步驟⑤比對的是資產總計與負債總額
text.en: Thinking step 5 compares total assets with total liabilities

statement.zh-TW: 能從亮紅燈的勾稽點推論最可能填錯的格子，先修最上游的那一格，並說明差額只是線索而不是答案
statement.en: Work out from the check points that light up red which cell is most likely wrong, fix the one furthest upstream first, and explain that the difference is a clue rather than the answer

text.zh-TW: 看到兩個勾稽點亮紅燈就以為有兩個地方填錯
text.en: Assuming two red check points mean two separate mistakes

text.zh-TW: 先改最下游的合計數字，而不是先找最上游填錯的格子
text.en: Adjusting the downstream totals first instead of finding the upstream cell that is wrong

text.zh-TW: 以為勾稽不上一定是現金流量表的錯
text.en: Assuming a failed check must come from a mistake in the statement of cash flows

text.zh-TW: 以為勾稽點的差額一定等於漏記那筆交易的金額
text.en: Assuming the difference at a check point must equal the amount of the missed transaction

text.zh-TW: 以為一格填錯只會讓直接比對它的那個勾稽點亮紅燈
text.en: Thinking a wrong cell only turns red the check point that compares it directly

statement.zh-TW: 能預測一筆交易對現金、存貨與五層利益的方向與金額，並填出勾稽點兩邊應該出現的數字
statement.en: Predict the direction and amount of a transaction’s effect on cash, inventories and the five profit levels, and fill in the figures that should appear on both sides of a check point

text.zh-TW: 以為賒銷沒收到現金，所以五層利益不會變
text.en: Thinking a credit sale leaves the five profit levels unchanged because no cash was received

text.zh-TW: 以為進貨的當下營業成本就會增加
text.en: Thinking cost of sales rises the moment goods are purchased

text.zh-TW: 以為付利息會讓營業利益減少
text.en: Thinking paying interest reduces operating profit

text.zh-TW: 以為提列折舊會讓現金減少
